topic: Phases of the Moon and scientific models
key_concepts: The Moon is Earth's natural satellite.
The Moon shines by reflecting sunlight from the Sun.
The Moon's phases depend on its position relative to Earth and the Sun.
The main phases include new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter.
Waxing phases grow brighter while waning phases grow dimmer.
The Moon can sometimes be seen during daytime, especially early morning or late afternoon.
The Moon's apparent color can vary due to the angle of arriving sunlight.
The Moon does not truly disappear during new moon; its dark side faces Earth.
